summary: Design-foundation local contract is coherent for the bounded six-family Figma build: 61 primitive, 65 semantic and 37 component tokens (163 total), Light/Dark aliases and CSS export, 44 exact variants, required permission/tool status meanings, contrast and state bindings. Corrected focus variants use a 2px semantic surface gap and 2px ring; danger default/hover/pressed and navigation default/hover resolve to distinct colors in both modes. python3 docs/design/validate_system.py passes. Review covers the local specification and validator only; actual Figma placement, bindings, fonts and render remain separate live evidence gates.
